title: Metric tile
summary: A metric tile: a label, a value with its unit, the change against a previous period said in words and by an arrow, a limit as a meter with thresholds, a status with a short hint, a slot for a chart, a skeleton while it loads, and the whole tile as one link or button. Tiles stand in a row that wraps (sf-tile-metric-grid).

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

label.description: What the number is, in a few words («Диск», «Подкачка», «Посетители»): the tile's accessible name. Without it the tile is named «Показатель» / «Metric»

value.description: The number. Unset, the tile says «—»

value-text.description: The value as the page writes it («83 %», «1,2 млн»), in place of the formatted number; value still feeds the change and the limit

format.description: How the value, the change and the limit are written, in the page language (SF.format.number words): number, integer, decimal-<n>, percent (a share 0..1), compact, currency-<CODE> or unit-<Intl unit> (unit-gigabyte, unit-percent)

unit.description: A word after the value for a unit Intl does not know («запросов/с», «сайтов»); drawn smaller, on the value's baseline

previous.description: The value of the previous period; the change is worked out from it when delta is not given

delta.description: The change itself, when the page has it; it wins over previous

delta-format.description: How the change is written: its share of the previous value, the difference in the value's format, or both. Without a previous value it is the difference

period-text.description: What the change is against, after it: «к прошлой неделе»

better.description: Whether a rise is good: up for visitors, down for load, errors or a queue, none when neither. The change's tone follows its meaning, not its sign

max.description: A limit: the tile shows the value of max with a meter (a disk, a quota, licence seats)

limit-text.description: The words under the meter in place of «45 ГБ из 100 ГБ»

warning-at.description: A threshold in per cent of max: from it on, the meter and the tile are a warning by themselves (sf-progress-bar's warning-at). The page sets it; the tile only compares

error-at.description: A threshold in per cent of max: from it on, the meter and the tile are an error by themselves

status.description: The page's statement about the number, in the shared status vocabulary: a status icon of that tone before the hint. With warning-at or error-at the tile takes the more serious of this and the threshold the limit reached

hint.description: A short line beside the status: «серверу не хватает памяти»

href.description: Makes the whole tile one link to this address

openable.description: Without href: makes the whole tile one button that sends open

loading.description: The value is on its way: the tile keeps its size, the label stays, the value, the change and the limit are skeleton bars, aria-busy is true

size.description: The rung of the size ladder: the label and the lines under the value are the rung below, the value two rungs up, the insets the rung's. 1/2 for a dense row, 2 for a page's headline figure

sf-tile-metric-open.summary: A person pressed an openable tile (a click, Enter or Space): open {id} of vocabulary 1.1.5 §5, id being the element's id; the host opens the details

forbidden_client_responsibilities: loading or polling the number (the host sets value)
inventing a threshold (the host sets warning-at and error-at)
deciding whether a rise is good (the host sets better)

keyboard: A link or button tile is one Tab stop; Enter follows the link, Enter or Space presses the button
accessibility.focus: A plain tile takes no focus; a link or button tile shows the focus ring on its whole surface.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-tile-metric for one number that matters on an admin or dashboard screen: server load, storage used of a quota, visitors against last week, queue depth, licence seats.
do_not: Do not put buttons or links inside the tile; make the whole tile one link (href) or button (openable)
Do not compute a status from the value in the page and pass it as colour; give warning-at and error-at, or status with a hint
Do not use the tile for a list of numbers; use a description list or a table
ai_guidance.minimal_example: <sf-tile-metric label="Диск" value="83" max="100" format="unit-gigabyte" warning-at="80" error-at="95" hint="Свободно меньше 20 %"></sf-tile-metric>
